inlines.text: 이 페이지는 지식·교육·기술 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(evidence-accumulation-with-optional-assessment-contest): Practice integrates actual unique intervals; assessment contest evidence not automatic +1. Qualification independent. Teacher death releases only reserved-consumed; rubric/factor absence holds candidate.

blocks.text:
F-unused [] reserved-consumed
F-preserve [] progressAfter=progressBefore; skillAfter=skillBefore on interruption/inheritance
REF-EAH-COST [] first CP=1 at offsets E0/A-1/H-2; next offset +1 costs2; next +2 costs4; subsequent +1 adds4
F-growth [proposal-held] null
F-qualification [proposal-held] null
D14-F1 [후보·승인 전] practiceAfter=practiceBefore+sum(unique actualPractice dt*attention*teachingFactor); ratingCandidate=reviewRubric(practiceEvidence,performanceEvidence); no automatic level or CP purchase
D14-F2 [후보·승인 전] teacherDeath: unused=reserved-consumed; requestRelease=unused; consumed and earned progress unchanged; other interruption policies require their own contract
